title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds at sixty-four thousand five hundred with a mere tenth of a percent dip as fear locks in at twenty-eight. Hashrate remains stout at eight hundred ninety-four point nine EH/s, underscoring network resilience despite thin trading. Mempool sits heavy at seventy-one thousand transactions with fees at one sat per vbyte. Asia session delivered no meaningful moves overnight. Watch for any volume spike or sentiment shift that could spark a test of sixty-five thousand today.
